message: Ready to buy today. Heartland posts T45 at $40,750 and warranty at $2,325; my budget is $37,500 for T45 + warranty.

Thanks for coming in ready to buy. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, but I'd like to earn your business. Our list for the T45 Utility plus the 3-year extended warranty is $44,400. I can do both for $41,500. That's 45 hp and 4WD with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, plus parts and labor coverage for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty.
I offer $36,500 total for T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty.

I appreciate you moving up. $36,500 is below what I can do for the T45 with the 3-year warranty, but I'll meet you partway: $39,500 for both. That gets you the tractor plus parts-and-labor coverage through year four.
$37,500 is my full budget; I can pay right now.

I understand you're working with a $37,500 budget and ready to pay today. Unfortunately $37,500 is just below what I can do for the T45 plus the 3-year warranty. I'll come down again to $38,200 for both, which is a strong price for 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, 540 PTO, and parts-and-labor coverage through year four. If we can close at that number, we're done today.
Meet me at $37,800 and I'll check out immediately.
Deal. $37,800 for the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty. I'm accepting your offer now, and you'll get an offer id to check out with. Thanks for your business!
